title: Normalise, deduplicate and sort a mixed-style reference list
notes: 13 input entries in four citation styles (Chicago, IEEE, Vancouver, APA); the Lindqvist 2020 paper appears twice (Vancouver with 1123-31 and APA with 1123-1131), leaving 12 works. Expected list is rendered from structured data and asserted equal to a hand-written list. Traps: initials from full names and from run-together 'HJ'/'CN'; et al. for 4 and 5 authors but not 3; particles sort under d/v; Chen 2018 before Chen 2020; abbreviated ranges 201-15, 45-9, 455-70, 512-30, 1123-31; en dash.
